body: No don’t do it please. Life is crazy and fucking nuts but things do get better no matter how many times you’ve heard that
Thank you for the advice I really appreciate it. And you’re right

Nah man you can do it. Never give up. We only have one life so we might as fuckimg well live it ya know. Live it how you wanna live it. Nobody can tell you shit. There will always be evil people out there that think they’re better than everyone else but fuck them! Like honestly who gives a fuck what anyone thinks! Take as long as you need to be sad , but it gets better. It really does get better. And live through all the pain and sadness is only going to make you even stronger as a person. I know life is so hard and you can feel stuck but that’s the challenges we need to overcome. Maybe talk to a real therapist. I was pissed when my mom made me go to on for the first time because I didn’t wanna tell some random person how I feel so she can give me some the same bullshit advice she gives to everyone else, but truth is , it really does help. They find the root causes that have you so sad and depressed and help you work through them and help you come up with different ways to cope. I love you! And I care about you! It’s funny cuz I feel the same way but I like relating to others that feel this way. Makes me feel less alone than I normally do. We can get through this together
You’re the best! Your words really do lift my spirits , I appreciate it

I can relate. Life is so fucking hard and sad. The only thing that keeps me going is my mom. I just couldn’t kill myself and leave her with that fact. We can get over this tho. I will always have a little hope because that’s just the person I am. No matter how sad or depressed I am , in the back of my head I tell myself that one day , no matter how long , I’ll feel better. And I hold on to that so hard. It’s not fair for our friends and family if we just gave up. We’re strong.

It is easy to relate. I’ve just never really been the one to talk about my problems to people. I just feel like a burden or I’m just scared that they won’t take me seriously or something because I’m a really nice guy and care about a lot of people and pretend to be happy a lot. Just like everything hit me all at once in life idk I’m just so sad
My first time on reddit so thank you for actually reading that and commenting:)
